verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a framework for building agents (tools, structured output, durable execution, deferred/approval tools) that are invoked programmatically or via a CLI/queue, but the evidence pack shows no declarative rule-engine or event-trigger system (e.g., 'on event X, automatically run Y') — durable execution and background queues describe execution environments, not rule definitions for automatic triggering. missing for 10: any documented rule/trigger definition mechanism, event-listener API, or evidence of automatic action-firing on external events.
